notes: Imported from the Rivers of London rulebook (Rogues’ Gallery / case Cast).

sheet.name: DS Sahra Guleed
sheet.backstory: A dependable Met detective sergeant of Somali descent and the Folly's regular ally ('ninja-in-training'); engaged to Michael Cheung.

magic_spells.name: None that she's admitted to-yet. Given who her teacher is
any she does know are going to be non-Newtonian and most likely movement-based

custom_fields.value: Sahra possesses a Wizard's Sword (page 235). This sword contains a store of 10 magic points.

The sound of ripping silk whenever she wields her sword. *Sahra's version of the Magical advantage is slightly different to that available to investigators and most NPCs, and manifests itself as the Mystic Art of Fighting (nearby). Footnote: 2 Moon Over Soho
